match.userMessage:
Rough storyboard sketch. Scene 1 — 5s
INT. WALK-UP APARTMENT, KITCHEN COUNTER — LATE AFTERNOON
Overhead flat-lay, locked, hard window light throwing clean shadows on a bone-white counter: a cracked flip phone, a folded set list on a napkin, two subway tokens, half a bagel, and a squat coral lipstick still sealed in its box. Scarlett's hand enters frame, thumbs the box open, and taps the tube out onto the counter, where it rolls a half-turn and stops against the napkin. Coral against white and oat-beige.

. Loose pencil line drawing on white paper, quick gestural strokes, minimal detail. Simple placeholder figures with blank featureless faces, basic shapes for the setting, flat grey marker shading. Monochrome, no colour, no rendering, no realism, no photographic detail. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
